Department: Surgery / Orthopedics

Prioritize:
- trauma mechanism, function loss, instability, tendon or ligament pattern, and whether normal X-ray still leaves a soft-tissue injury highly likely;
- physical exam maneuvers that are decisive for tendon avulsion or instability.

Watch for:
- routing atraumatic or inflammatory joint problems here by keyword only;
- dismissing tendon injury because plain films are normal.
